verdict.rationale: The only calendar-feed evidence covers the reverse direction: importing team holidays from an external iCal feed into incident.io, then showing them alongside shifts. Nothing documents exporting a user's on-call shifts as a subscribable feed for a personal calendar. Webhooks that sync schedule changes to external tools are a developer building block, not a personal calendar feed, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, my shifts sync to my personal calendar via a feed so I always know when I'm on the hook
